label: Impose a tax on family farms
description: The proposal introduces a specific tax targeting family farms to address inheritance tax avoidance loopholes.

label: Pass the Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill to legalise assisted dying
description: The proposal seeks to enact legislation allowing terminally ill adults to request assistance in ending their lives.

label: Pass the Football Governance Bill to establish an independent football regulator
description: The proposal seeks to create a new independent body to oversee governance and regulation of English football clubs.

label: Pass the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill
description: The proposal is to enact legislation aimed at improving child protection and standardizing school performance measures.

label: Expand apprenticeships and technical education
description: The proposal aims to increase the number and quality of apprenticeships and technical education programs.

label: Establish Skills England as an independent executive agency
description: The proposal creates a new independent executive agency named Skills England to oversee technical education and apprenticeships.

label: Remove tax exemption on independent school fees
description: The proposal removes the zero-rating status for independent school fees to generate revenue for the state education system.

label: Ban mobile phone use in schools
description: The proposal requires all schools to prohibit students from using mobile phones during the entire school day.

label: Ban exploitative zero-hours contracts and end fire and rehire practices
description: The proposal seeks to prohibit zero-hours contracts that do not reflect regular hours and stop employers from firing staff to rehire them at lower pay.

label: Enact the Water (Special Measures) Bill to hold water companies accountable for sewage pollution
description: This proposal introduces a specific Act to place failing water companies into special measures and enforce stricter accountability for sewage spills.

label: Enact the Illegal Migration Act to curb illegal migration and strengthen border security
description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that removes the duty to remove illegal entrants and strengthens border controls.

label: Pass the Universal Credit and Personal Independence Payment Bill
description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that raises universal credit allowances and alters personal independence payment eligibility criteria.

label: Create Great British Railways
description: Establish a new public body to manage and oversee the United Kingdom's railway network.

label: Amend the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953 to strengthen legislation against livestock worrying
description: The proposal seeks to update the 1953 Act to better protect farmed animals from dog attacks and expand the scope of offences.

label: Increase defence spending to £2.6 billion in-year cuts
description: The proposal seeks to reverse planned £2.6 billion cuts to the Ministry of Defence's operating budget this year.

label: Enshrine the armed forces covenant into law across all areas of Government
description: This proposal legally binds all government departments to consider the unique needs of service personnel and their families.

label: Reform the non-domestic rating system in England
description: The proposal seeks to change how businesses in England are taxed on their properties.

label: Impose fines on parents for term-time school holidays
description: The proposal requires parents to pay penalties if they remove their children from school during approved holiday periods.

label: Establish school-based nurseries in existing school classrooms
description: The proposal involves converting unused space in schools into new nursery facilities to increase childcare capacity.

label: Increase 16-to-19 funding rates and provide additional capital for further education colleges
description: The proposal seeks to raise per-student funding rates for 16-to-19 year olds and allocate extra capital to upgrade college infrastructure.

label: Require home-educated children to be registered with local authorities
description: The proposal mandates that parents of home-educated children must register them with their local authority.

label: Reform the Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) system
description: The proposal seeks to overhaul the existing framework for assessing and supporting children with special educational needs and disabilities.

label: Require academies to follow the national curriculum
description: The proposal mandates that all academies must adhere to the national curriculum requirements.

label: Increase investment in mainstream and special educational needs schools
description: The proposal seeks to raise funding for both mainstream and special educational needs schools to address resource shortages.

label: Abolish the narrow knowledge-rich curriculum in favour of a holistic approach
description: The proposal seeks to replace the current knowledge-rich curriculum with a broader, holistic educational model.

label: Cut funding for the International Baccalaureate in state schools
description: The proposal seeks to reduce government financial support for state schools offering the International Baccalaureate qualification.

label: Abolish the English Baccalaureate (EBacc) performance measure
description: The proposal seeks to remove the EBacc metric used to assess secondary school performance in England.

label: Implement the Review of Relationship, Sex and Health Education guidance
description: The proposal seeks to update the national guidance for relationship, sex, and health education in schools.

label: Expand funded childcare entitlement from 15 to 30 hours per week
description: The proposal increases the weekly hours of government-funded childcare available to working parents from 15 to 30.

label: Recruit 6,500 additional teachers
description: The proposal is to hire 6,500 new teachers to improve school standards and support inclusive education.

label: Require all teachers in academies to hold qualified teacher status
description: The proposal mandates that every teacher employed by academy schools must possess Qualified Teacher Status.

label: Cap branded school uniform items to three per year with a fourth allowed for ties
description: The proposal limits secondary school pupils to wearing no more than three different branded uniform items annually, or four if a tie is included.

label: Implement a four-day school week
description: The proposal seeks to reduce the standard school week from five days to four days.

label: Remove automatic requirement for schools requiring improvement to become academies
description: The proposal seeks to end the rule that forces schools needing improvement to immediately convert to academy status.

label: Integrate play into the key stage 1 curriculum
description: The proposal requires adding play-based learning activities to the mandatory curriculum for children aged 5 to 7.

label: Require compulsory Special Educational Needs and Disabilities training for all teachers and staff
description: The proposal mandates that every teacher and teaching staff member must complete specialized training in Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.

label: Raise university tuition fees
description: The proposal seeks to increase the amount students must pay for higher education.

label: Abolish all existing academies and replace them with state-run schools
description: The proposal seeks to end the academy system entirely and return all schools to direct state control.

label: Abolish level 7 apprenticeships
description: The proposal seeks to end the government scheme allowing postgraduate-level apprenticeships.

label: Include financial education in the school curriculum
description: The proposal mandates the inclusion of financial education as a subject within the national school curriculum.

label: Abolish or restrict the right to Education, Health and Care Plans
description: The proposal seeks to end or limit the legal entitlement for children with special needs to receive an Education, Health and Care Plan.

label: Introduce free breakfast clubs in primary schools
description: The proposal establishes free breakfast clubs for all primary school pupils to improve attendance and reduce hunger.

label: Expand free school meals to lift 100,000 children out of poverty
description: The proposal extends free school meal eligibility to an additional 100,000 children to reduce child poverty.

label: Mandatory solar panel installation on all new homes
description: The proposal requires every newly constructed house to be fitted with solar panels.

label: Establish Great British Energy
description: The proposal creates a new publicly owned energy company to generate clean electricity and support community energy schemes.

label: Grant mayors new planning powers to intervene in major strategic planning applications
description: The proposal allows mayors to override local councils on specific large-scale development projects.

label: Abolish the two-tier council structure in Lancashire to implement a unitary structure
description: The proposal seeks to replace the existing two-tier local government system in Lancashire with a single unitary authority.

label: Pass the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Bill
description: The proposal is to enact legislation that devolves powers to local authorities and communities while creating new strategic bodies.

label: Abolish NHS England
description: The proposal seeks to dissolve NHS England to streamline health services and reduce duplication.

label: Create a single digital patient record for the NHS
description: The proposal establishes one unified digital record to track patient information across all NHS services.

label: Introduce rent caps on annual increases and rents in advance
description: The proposal seeks to limit how much landlords can raise rents each year and restrict upfront rent payments to one month.

label: Abolish section 21 no-fault evictions in the Renters' Rights Bill
description: The proposal seeks to end the legal mechanism allowing landlords to evict tenants without providing a specific reason.

label: Repeal the Safety of Rwanda (Asylum and Immigration) Act 2024
description: The proposal seeks to annul the 2024 legislation that established the legal framework for sending asylum seekers to Rwanda.

label: Introduce new civil respect orders for persistent antisocial behaviour offenders
description: The proposal creates new civil orders allowing courts to ban adults from specific antisocial activities, with breaches treated as criminal offences.

label: Introduce income tax on dividends, savings, and property income in the Finance Bill
description: The proposal introduces a new income tax charge specifically targeting dividends, savings, and property income within the Finance Bill.

label: Approve the British Indian Ocean Territory Bill to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius
description: The proposal seeks to enact legislation transferring sovereignty of the Chagos Islands from the UK to Mauritius.

label: Ratify the British Indian Ocean Territory Bill to establish the Chagos Marine Protected Area
description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that formally ratifies an international treaty creating a marine protected area in the Chagos archipelago.

label: Remove the two-child benefit cap in the Universal Credit system
description: The proposal seeks to eliminate the restriction that limits income support to the first two children of a family.

label: Require AI companies to disclose copyrighted works used to train their models
description: The proposal mandates that artificial intelligence developers must reveal which copyrighted materials were used in their training datasets.

label: Require the railway to have a target for passenger growth
description: The proposal mandates that the railway operator must set a specific goal to increase the number of passengers.
